newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel reclaims some lost ground, diffs mixed.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel reclaims some lost ground, diffs mixed.

text.p: U.S. cash jet fuel jumped sharply in New York Harbor and moderately in the Gulf Coast on Friday, players said, but continued to face uncertain prospects amid plentiful supply and waning demand.

New York Harbor 54-grade jet rose one cent with October futures and a 0.50-cent firming of diffs, erasing just a fraction of Thursday's three-cent loss amid a heavy selloff of Colonial Pipeline barrels. Gulf material edged 0.35-cent higher with futures more than offsetting softer diffs.
"Everyone's maximizing distillates since winter's coming," one Gulf traders said. "So that means more jet fuel."
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1632
